one_line: Early Tamil grammarian and theorist of landscape-poetics in the evolving Tolkappiyam tradition.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s to early 40s, slim but sturdy scholar’s build
appearance.face: oval face with warm medium-brown complexion, straight nose, sharp but kind dark-brown eyes with slightly arched brows, faint stubble shadow at jaw, a single thin vertical vibhuti line on the forehead, default expression calm and attentive with a slight thoughtful half-smile
appearance.hair: rich black hair tied back into a neat low bun at the nape, front kept smooth with a small center part, no shaved portions; wears a simple narrow cream-coloured cloth headband that circles the head above the ears and knots at the back
appearance.costume: era-appropriate Tamilakam scholar attire: a knee-length off-white cotton anga-vastram style upper cloth wrapped firmly around the torso like a short tunic with short half-sleeves, and a ankle-length unstitched veshti/dhoti of undyed cotton with a muted maroon woven border, pleated in front and wrapped around the waist, secured with a thin braided cord; over the left shoulder falls a separate light ochre shawl (uttariya) with a subtle narrow striped pattern at the edges; he wears a simple tulsi-bead necklace, a single small copper bangle on the right wrist, and plain leather sandals; fabric is matte, slightly textured handwoven cotton, with no ornate embroidery, only subtle border patterns
appearance.signature: A rolled palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with a thin dark cord, held in his left hand, with one leaf slightly protruding and etched with faint Tamil script lines.

ref_desc: Tolkappiyar is a mid-30s slim Tamil scholar with medium-brown skin, black hair in a low bun and a cream headband, wearing an off-white tunic, maroon-bordered veshti, ochre shawl, simple beads and bangle, carrying a rolled palm-leaf manuscript, in off-white, ochre, maroon, brown and black tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Tolkappiyar: a mid-30s slim Tamil male scholar with an oval medium-brown face, sharp dark-brown eyes, faint jaw stubble shadow and a single thin vertical vibhuti line on his forehead, his rich black hair tied in a neat low bun at the nape with a smooth center part and a narrow cream cloth headband circling his head above the ears. Show him in era-appropriate early historic Tamilakam scholar clothing: a knee-length off-white cotton upper cloth wrapped snugly as a short tunic with short half-sleeves; a long unstitched veshti/dhoti of undyed cotton with a muted maroon woven border, pleated in front and wrapped to the ankles, held by a thin braided waist cord; and a separate light ochre shawl draped from his right shoulder across the chest and hanging over the left shoulder with subtle narrow stripes at its edges. Add a simple tulsi-bead necklace, one small copper bangle on his right wrist, and plain brown leather sandals. Place a rolled palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with a dark cord in his left hand, one leaf slightly protruding with faint etched Tamil script lines, while his right hand relaxes by his side or lightly adjusts the shawl. Use a restrained palette of off-white, ochre, muted maroon, medium browns and black, and present him in multiple views (front, side, back) with consistent face, hair, costume and manuscript prop in a clean shonen-anime line style, dignified and calm.
